The shared application layout used directly by DevStudio and Roma.

Source structure 
<div class="main-container">
  <aside class="left-nav" aria-label="Example navigation">
    <strong class="heading-5">Product</strong>
    <nav aria-label="Example sections">
      <a class="body-s" href="#overview">Overview</a>
      <a class="body-s" href="#content">Content</a>
      <a class="body-s" href="#settings">Settings</a>
    </nav>
  </aside>

  <main class="page">
    <button type="button" data-navigation-scrim aria-label="Close navigation"></button>
    <header class="page__header">
      <div>
        <h1 class="heading-2">Page title</h1>
        <p class="body-s">Page description explains what can be managed here.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="page__actions">
        <button class="diet-btn-txt" type="button" data-size="md" data-variant="primary">
          <span class="diet-btn-txt__label">Primary action</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <div class="page__content">
      <p class="body-s">Consumer-owned page content uses the shared Dieter page composition.</p>
    </div>
  </main>
</div>
